title: Milestones

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Here we are, where the farm road leaves the valley. We're setting little stones along the road, all the same distance apart.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Then a walker can count the stones and know how far they've come. Use this stick to measure each space.

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put a stone one stick away from the signpost. Then one stick away from that stone, and so on. Lay the stick down to measure.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the signpost. Where does the other end reach? Put a stone there.

feedback.placed_all: Now let's check with the stick. Does it fit each space?
feedback.crowded: Look: the stick covers a stone there. Can that stone move further along?
feedback.far: Look: there's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that stone move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one stick long. Now the road can be counted!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: Next time you walk to the farm, count the stones as you pass. One, two, three... and there's the farm!

journal_line: I set milestones along the farm road with Mr. Amos.
